'''French toast''' is a filling [[bread]] dish that heals {{Hp|10}} and has no effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/french_toast.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
An egg, sugar, estus ash and bread (or [[naan]]). Obtaining bread unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating French toast takes 1.8 seconds and heals {{Hp|10}}.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].
